records.source_Japanese: 沼に入る
records.source_meaning: Enter the swamp.
records.exchange_context: Sakura asks about the map, sees the party off and does not claim to accompany the whole expedition. A swamp blocks the journey; entering gives a shallow shortcut and fatigue, while turning back costs a day and a detour. Gerhard expects arrival soon and a companion spots the destination. Preserve both paths and every source voice alternative.

records.source_Japanese: 追い払う
records.source_meaning: Drive the wolf away.
records.exchange_context: A complete map-gated forest expedition with a wolf encounter and three choices. A scare attempt can injure Hodram; a companion can warn/intervene and be hurt, followed by Hodram’s apology and another companion’s reassurance about prompt treatment and the wolf leaving. Escape, fatigue/departures, forest exit and destination sighting are alternatives. Preserve dynamic role distinctions, all eight-slot aliases and uncertainty; no guaranteed healing, animal death, kinship or numerical casualties.
